Prerequisite(s): —

Benefit: As a standard action, the time mage can attempt to steal a crucial moment from a target's future, reducing the chance the target will enjoy a happy and prosperous future. The time mage spends a mote and the target must make a Will save (DC 10 + half of the time mage's level + his Intelligence modifier) or suffer a penalty to all attack and damage rolls, skill checks, and saving throws. This effect lasts for 1 round per time mage level. The penalty suffered is equal to -1, and increases to -2 at 8th level, and -3 at 16th level, while the time mage gains this as a bonus as he uses the stolen fate to carefully plan each action he takes. Steal Fate has a range of 30 feet.
